messages.subject: Announcement: Distance 3.5 released
parts:
________________________________________________

RESEARCH UNIT FOR WILDLIFE POPULATION ASSESSMENT
ANNOUNCEMENT
NEW SOFTWARE - DISTANCE 3.5
________________________________________________


Distance version 3.5 is now available for download via the world-wide web.

The web site address for download is:

http://www.ruwpa.st-and.ac.uk/distance/

This site is also the new home page for program Distance.

Distance 3.5 is a new, fully windows-based update of the standard distance
sampling software Distance. Distance provides an analysis of distance
sampling data to estimate density and abundance of a biological population.

The new software is a major update on previous versions. It features a much
simplified point-and-click interface, with analyses displayed in a "live"
summary table, allowing interactive data modeling and model selection.
Several new features include the ability to select subsets of the data for
anlalysis, to import data from text files and to post-stratify on factors
such as age, sex, etc. For a list of the new features, see the Distance home
page.

If you have any comments about the new program or the web pages, please
contact us at dist...@mcs.st-and.ac.uk.

- Len Thomas
Distance development project co-ordinator
